title: אבא ביראה
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.

paragraphs: Abba Bira'ah, son of Eliezer ben Yaakov, says, Menachot 93b. Uncertain: Abba his name, Bira'ah his place—read “in Eliezer ben Yaakov’s name”? Or Abba a title like Rabbi (see Rabbah), as Abba Shaul, and Bira'ah his name, son of Eliezer ben Yaakov? Requires examination; see Birna below. Or read Abba Bira'ah of Eliezer ben Yaakov’s school. See Chanina bar Minyomi; new editions uncorrected.
